answer: Each identity binds one certified organic farm: the certifier inspects soil, seed, spray logs and issues one certificate per farm and identity, a mirror the register can check. A yarrow border marks the certified rows; it lapses if an annual inspection fails. Earning it costs 1,800 units and a 1,095-day wait. One farm backs one identity; a second claim on the same fields fails. 100 fakes need 100 farms, 180,000 units and 300 farm-years. Cheapest cheat: renting a certified farm for 1,200 units a season, but the lender loses its own anchor, and a forged marble seal fails the serial check.
